commitments.detail: Update the campaign traveler to reflect the customer drawing revision requirements: 8 brackets for destructive testing and 100% dimensional inspection of the first 20 brackets, before any release to Cell 3.
Open the work order, replace fixture F-19's jaws using the J-19 replacement kit, and validate the jaws — 3 hours of maintenance work — before any release to Cell 3.

Approve the temporary route change and release the 300-bracket campaign to Cell 3 only after all four area commitments (quality traveler update, maintenance jaw replacement and validation, materials inventory adjustment, and safety filter change plus airflow verification) are complete.
